# RadioTech Studio
> Complete online radio setup, automation, streaming, and support services worldwide.

RadioTech Studio is a specialist service that builds and fixes complete online radio platforms — from automation software and streaming servers to websites, mobile apps, VPS infrastructure, and 24/7 support. Trusted by stations in 15+ countries.

## Services
- Radio automation setup (RadioBOSS, RadioDJ, SAM Broadcaster, AzuraCast, LibreTime, Rivendell, Mixxx)
- Streaming server configuration (Icecast, Shoutcast, Liquidsoap)
- Cloud radio platforms (AzuraCast VPS, Docker, SSL, AutoDJ)
- Radio websites and mobile apps (WordPress, custom HTML, Android, iOS)
- Radio hosting panels (Centova Cast, Everest Cast, WHMCS)
- OBS and video streaming (YouTube 24/7, Facebook Live, FFmpeg)
- VPS and server setup (Linux, Docker, Nginx, SSL, Cloudflare)
- SaaS and custom platforms (PHP, Laravel, React, Next.js)
- Monthly maintenance and emergency support
